description: This file defines a class MessagePayloadSerializer responsible for serializing and deserializing message payloads within a messaging system. It handles conversion between raw payloads, JSON representations, and encoded formats such as Base64, while also performing size validation and content type considerations.

classes.name: MessagePayloadSerializer
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to serialize and deserialize message payloads, supporting different content types and encoding schemes, with size validation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the message payload into a JSON object, handling raw payloads, JSON payloads, and encoding as necessary.

methods.name: interpretAsJsonValue
methods.description: Converts a payload string into a JsonValue, encoding as JSON or plain string depending on content type.

methods.name: injectMessagePayload
methods.description: Injects the serialized payload into the message builder, with size validation.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON payload into a message builder, considering content type and handling base64 decoding if necessary.

methods.name: tryToBase64Decode
methods.description: Attempts to decode a byte array from Base64, fallback to original bytes if decoding fails.
